objective_pt: Falar do que você faz no tempo livre com "I like + -ing", dizer com que frequência (always, usually, sometimes, never) e convidar com "Do you want to...?".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer com hobbies que o aluno já tem.
prompts: What do you do in your free time?
watchFor: Dizer "I like play soccer"; depois de "like" use "-ing" ou "to".
Dizer "practice soccer"; com esportes de bola usamos "play".

exercises.prompt: In my free time, I like reading and watching movies.
accepted: In my free time, I like reading and watching movies
In my free time I like reading and watching films

exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de "like" o verbo vai com "-ing" (I like playing) ou com "to" (I like to play).

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu gosto de ouvir música."
accepted: I like to listen to music
I love to listen to music
I really like listening to music

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Listen" precisa de "to": "listen to music".
Depois de "like" use "-ing" ou "to": "I like listening" ou "I like to listen".
Para música, "ouvir" com atenção é "listen to". "Hear" é escutar sem querer.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender atividades de lazer (play soccer, go running, go to the movies, hang out with friends) e advérbios de frequência.
prompts: How often do you go to the movies?
What do you do on Sundays?
watchFor: Colocar o advérbio no fim: "I go to the gym always"; o natural é "I always go".

exercises.example_en: On Saturdays I hang out with friends.
I go running in the park on Sundays.
I usually watch series at night.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "Eu jogo futebol com meus amigos."
accepted: I play soccer with my friends
I play football with my friends
I play soccer with my buddies

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com esportes de bola usamos "play": "I play soccer".
commonErrors.correction_en: I play soccer with my friends.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com esportes não usamos "the": "play soccer".
commonErrors.correction_en: I play soccer with my friends.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar o "-ing" (som nasal no fundo da boca, sem "gui" no fim) e a tônica de "usually".
watchFor: Falar "readingui" ou "readin" com "n" na frente da boca.
Pronunciar "usually" como "u-su-a-li"; o "s" soa como o "j" de "já".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "-ing" termina no fundo da boca, sem "gui".
exercises.prompt: I love swimming, dancing and cooking.
accepted: I love swimming, dancing and cooking

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Usually": o "s" soa como o "j" de "já".
exercises.prompt: I usually go to the gym after work.
accepted: I usually go to the gym after work

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O advérbio de frequência vem antes do verbo: "I usually go".
commonErrors.correction_en: I usually go to the gym after work.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha com que frequência ela vai ao cinema.
exercises.listen: I sometimes go to the movies on Friday.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender alguém falando de hobbies e responder a um convite.
prompts: Do you want to go to the movies on Saturday?
watchFor: Responder um convite com "Yes, I want"; o natural é "Sure!", "Yes, I'd love to".
Recusar sem dar razão; "Sorry, I can't. I'm busy" soa mais gentil.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que o Mark faz no fim de semana.
exercises.listen: On weekends, Mark plays tennis in the morning and plays video games at night.
options: Tennis in the morning, video games at night.
Video games in the morning, tennis at night.
Tennis in the morning and at night.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Plays tennis in the morning and plays video games at night": tênis de manhã, videogame à noite.

exercises.listen: Do you want to go to the movies on Saturday?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Want" precisa de complemento. Para aceitar um convite diga "Yes, I'd love to" ou "Sure!".
Em inglês: "Sure!" ou "Of course!".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: você vai à academia três vezes por semana.
exercises.listen: How often do you go to the gym?
accepted: I go three times a week
I go to the gym three times a week
I go to the gym 3 times a week

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Por semana" é "a week": "three times a week".
"Vezes" é "times": "three times a week".

teacher.goal_pt: Conversar sobre hobbies com frequência e fazer um convite simples.
prompts: What do you like doing on weekends?
How often do you watch movies?
Do you want to play soccer with me?
watchFor: Advérbio de frequência depois do verbo: "I play always".
Dizer "Do you want go...?" sem o "to".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu nunca assisto TV."

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês não se usa dupla negação: "I never watch TV".
"Never" vem antes do verbo: "I never watch TV".
"Assist" é ajudar (falso cognato). Assistir TV é "watch TV".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você quer jogar futebol no domingo?"
accepted: Do you want to play soccer on Sunday?
Do you want to play football on Sunday?
Would you like to play soccer on Sunday?
Would you like to play football on Sunday?
Do you wanna play soccer on Sunday?
Do you want to play soccer this Sunday?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "want" vem "to": "Do you want to play...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to play soccer on Sunday?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Pergunta no presente começa com "Do": "Do you want to...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to play soccer on Sunday?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com dias da semana usamos "on": "on Sunday".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to play soccer on Sunday?

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: I sometimes go to the beach on weekends

exercises.instruction_pt: Conte o que você faz no tempo livre e convide a pessoa para fazer algo com você.
exercises.prompt_en: In my free time I play the guitar and I go running on Sundays. What do you like doing in your free time?
guidelines_pt: Diga 2 ou 3 coisas que você gosta de fazer: "I like reading...".
Diga com que frequência: "I usually..., I sometimes..., I never...".
Termine com um convite: "Do you want to... on Saturday?".

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar hobbies, "like + -ing", advérbios de frequência e convites; fechar o nível A1.
prompts: What do you never do on weekends?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Às vezes eu cozinho para a minha família."
accepted: Sometimes I cook for my family
I sometimes cook for my family
I cook for my family sometimes

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Às vezes" é "sometimes", uma palavra só.
commonErrors.correction_en: Sometimes I cook for my family.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Kitchen" é cozinha (o lugar). O verbo cozinhar é "cook".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sometimes I cook for my family.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cooker" é o fogão. Cozinhar é "cook".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sometimes I cook for my family.

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "swim".
exercises.sentence: My sister loves ___ in the sea.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "love" use "-ing" (swimming, com dois "m") ou "to swim".
commonErrors.correction_en: My sister loves swimming in the sea.

options: I always drink coffee in the morning.
I drink always coffee in the morning.
Always I drink coffee in the morning.
exercises.explanation_pt: Advérbios de frequência ficam antes do verbo principal: "I always drink".

exercises.prompt: Thanks for the chat! Have a great weekend!
accepted: Thanks for the chat! Have a great weekend!
Thank you for the chat. Have a great weekend
Thanks for the chat, have a nice weekend

practice.instruction_pt: Converse: ouça cada fala e responda em inglês.
practice.scene_pt: Um colega de trabalho conversa com você na sexta-feira à tarde.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Finally, Friday! What do you usually do on weekends?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que normalmente sai com os amigos.
accepted: I usually hang out with my friends
I usually go out with my friends
Usually I hang out with friends
I usually hang out with friends
I usually go out with friends
I usually spend time with my friends

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A palavra de frequência vem antes do verbo: "I always go".
commonErrors.correction_en: I usually hang out with my friends.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Sair com" amigos é "go out with" ou "hang out with".
commonErrors.correction_en: I usually hang out with my friends.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Cool. Do you play any sports?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que joga vôlei aos sábados.
accepted: Yes, I play volleyball on Saturdays
Yes, I do. I play volleyball on Saturdays
Yes, I play volleyball on Saturday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para esportes com bola, use "play": "play soccer".
Com dias da semana use "on": "on Saturdays".

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Nice! I like running. Do you want to go running with me on Sunday?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Aceite e pergunte a que horas.
accepted: Yes, I would love to. What time?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Que horas?" é "What time?".

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: How about eight in the morning?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que é cedo, mas tudo bem.
accepted: It is early, but that is fine

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o sujeito: "It's early".

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu adoro ler."

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "like/love" use o verbo com "-ing" (ou "to"): "I like reading".
"Ler" é "read"; "lecture" é palestra.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Ela nunca vai à academia."

She does not go to the gym

commonErrors.correction_en: She never goes to the gym.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Academia de ginástica é "gym".
commonErrors.correction_en: She never goes to the gym.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Nós jogamos futebol às quartas."

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para esportes com bola, use "play": "play soccer".

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu às vezes toco violão à noite."

I sometimes play the guitar in the evening
